phase_name: Redeploy, Migrate Live State, and Demonstrate /roadmap

objectives.description: Redeploy the tree via deploy-headless.sh; fix doc-lint/postflight-boundary/subject-resolution-declaration findings surfaced
Confirm the deploy landed the new surfaces
Take a durable checkpoint before the first live write (git-snapshot.sh 603 --no-revert)
Fix tight-list splitting and prose-paragraph mis-attribution bugs found via live-data dry-run
Run the migration for real against specs/ROADMAP.md and specs/state.json; verify Check 13/losslessness
Run --regenerate for real; prove idempotence; prove the unclassifiable-layout refusal still holds
Demonstrate /roadmap with no argument and /roadmap with a scoped instruction against the live repository

deviations.description: Dispatch context's Batch Gate Deferral directive instructs this dispatch to discharge the plan's declared full verify-deploy.sh gate against a scoped narrowing invocation instead, deferring the complete gate set to the batch-level stage; the plan's own Phase 7 verification text ('No --skip-slow and no --only-gate narrowing') is overridden by that directive for this dispatch
deviations.reason: The dispatch file's own Batch Gate Deferral section takes precedence for this specific dispatch. Ran bash .claude/scripts/tests/run-all.sh --only test-roadmap-generation.sh,test-migrate-roadmap-next-to-state.sh,test-roadmap-command-registration.sh,test-validate-state.sh,test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh (5/5 passed) as the scoped discharge. As corroborating (not substitute) evidence, bash .claude/scripts/deploy-headless.sh's own full verify-deploy.sh ran four times during this phase and reported only three failures every time, each independently confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to task 603 (gate10's 60s timeout on validate-state.sh --deep measured at 57.8s standalone -- a marginal, load-dependent timing issue; the eager-load budget and skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md ceiling overage, both last touched by an unrelated task per git log).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- scoped gate per dispatch directive, full gate deferred to batch stage)*

deviations.description: The harness's Agent-tool subagent_type roster does not recognize the newly-created 'roadmap-agent' type within the same session it was authored in (not live-reloaded mid-session). Both /roadmap demonstrations were performed via a general-purpose agent explicitly instructed to read and follow agents/roadmap-agent.md as its own operating contract verbatim -- the Self-Execution Fallback path skill-roadmap/SKILL.md's own Stage 2 already documents for exactly this situation.
deviations.reason: This is a harness registration-timing limitation, not a defect in the agent file itself; the fallback path is the one the skill's own contract names for this case.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- demonstrated via general-purpose standing in for roadmap-agent per the documented fallback)*
